description: Implementation class for ProductAttributeService, providing methods to retrieve, save, update, and delete product attributes in the catalog system.

classes.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for product attribute management, including retrieval, persistence, and deletion of product attributes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches product attributes matching a specific option ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Fetches product attributes matching a list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves product attributes corresponding to a specific option value ID.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Returns all product attributes associated with a specific product and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product attribute or updates an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product attribute, ensuring it exists before removal.
